The '''Balmorra Orbital Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Located in the [[Balmorra system/Legends|Balmorra system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], the station served as a way-station for Republic ships during the Republic's [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|attempt to reclaim]] the planet. As the world was under Imperial control during the early days of the war, Republic ships docked at the station and their passengers were forced to take shuttles to the [[Balmorran resistance]]'s base at [[Farnel Outpost]] in [[Bugtown]], a former [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetic research]] facility that had become overrun by the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Balmorra Orbital Station was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It serves as the spaceport for the Republic version of the planet Balmorra, and can only be accessed by Republic players with their own ship. Players then can take a shuttle down to the planet's surface.<ref name="TOR" />
